name: kuralbench_lite
description: KuralBench-lite: can a model quote a kural exactly? Two tasks over all 1,330 kurals, built by fixed templates: quote a kural by its number, and give the second line from the first. Score letter by letter with compare_key (tkcore.kuralbench.score), never with a model. Harness configs for Inspect and lm-evaluation-harness are in the GitHub repository under evals/. Every row carries the canary.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The user message, from a fixed English template with the kural number or its first line filled in.

fields.name: target_ta
fields.description: The expected answer, copied from kurals.lines_ta: the whole kural, or its second line.

fields.name: canary
fields.description: The canary string (see the card). Keep it with any copy of these rows.
